published_ranges._nozzle_by_speed: basic 170-190 (40-100 mm/s, fan 0-30%); high-speed printers setup 170-190 (40-200 mm/s, fan 0-80%) [product page + guide 8/2024]; TDS 2019 150-170
published_ranges._min_nozzle: TDS: 0.5 mm recommended; guide 8/2024: 0.5/0.6 mm for 1.75 mm filament, 0.6/0.8 mm for 2.85 mm; product page: 0.5 mm for 1.75, 0.8 mm for 2.85.
published_ranges._hardened_nozzle_required: Advised, not required: guide says hardened steel or ruby nozzles are advised to reduce wear.
published_ranges._fiber_content: Wood fibres (blend of biopolymers, mostly PLA).
published_ranges._ams: Guide notes the filament is more brittle than standard PLA and can break in tight/long paths, including an AMS.
published_ranges._notes: Melting temperature 145-160 C (TDS). 750 g + 230 g spool. Fields follow the current product page and 2024 guide.
